name: Sanskruti Banquet
description:
Sanskruti Hall, Malad East, Mumbai, is the face of elegance.
We offers a couple of mid-sized banquet hall from minimum 100 to 400 crowd. Though with dazzling marble floors, decorative ceilings adorned with dainty chandeliers & illuminated by an array of ceiling lights, the halls win big on ambience.
It is at a distance of 10 minutes from Malad Station & 24 minutes away from Goregaon Station. It is also well-connected by roads you & your guests will have no problem arriving at the venue. We also take care of catering & decor & provides additional perks like valet service & complimentary changing rooms. You can be assured that your important day will be permanently etched as a stunning affair.

featured_reviews.name: Selvaarun Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently, we hosted our wedding reception at Sanskruti Banquet, and it was truly one of our best decisions. Our host, Mr. Prajwal Thakur, was extremely helpful and dedicated. He took care of the entire event like a family member and ensured everything was handled perfectly and smoothly.

We highly recommend this venue for any function. The team celebrates your event as if it is their own, making the whole experience even more special.

Thank you, Mr. Prajwal Thakur, for the wonderful ambience and your pleasant hospitality.

featured_reviews.name: Umair Lucky
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Sanskruti Banquet is truly one of the best venues for hosting memorable events. From the moment we entered, we were impressed by the beautiful ambience, spacious hall, and elegant décor which perfectly suits weddings, receptions, engagements, birthdays, and corporate functions. The lighting and overall setup created a very classy and festive atmosphere.
The food deserves a special mention – absolutely delicious, fresh, and well presented. There was a wide variety of dishes, and every item tasted amazing. Guests appreciated both the quality and quantity of the food served. The catering team maintained excellent hygiene and timely service throughout the event.
The staff and management were extremely polite, professional, and cooperative. They paid attention to every small detail and ensured that all arrangements were handled smoothly without any stress for the hosts. From coordination to service, everything was managed in a very organized manner.
Cleanliness, seating arrangements, stage setup, and overall hospitality were top-notch. Many of our guests personally complimented the venue and the service. Sanskruti Banquet truly helped make our special occasion memorable and hassle-free.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for a classy venue with excellent food, great service, and a warm, welcoming experience

featured_reviews.name: Nilesh Shethiya
featured_reviews.review_text: Sanskruti hall is extreamly best hall in Malad East, Recently we organized baby shower event... Food was realy good & Management was Excellent... Specialy Thanks to Mr. Prajwal Bhai. He was really very helpful in every moment...

We booked this hall for my sister wedding on 5th Dec 2025 and our experience was excellent. The arrangements, cleanliness, and overall setup were all very well managed.
The management team was very cooperative and special thanks to Mr.Prajjwal ji, who was extremely helpful and supported us at every step, making everything run smoothly.
We truly appreciated the service and the polite behavior of the staff. Highly recommended 👍✨

featured_reviews.name: Bhavya Gour
featured_reviews.review_text: The best decision after searching and visiting so many banquets and Restaurants. Everyone loved the food, the decor, the service. If you are looking for a pocket-friendly worth place for celebrating your functions like birthday, engagement or Sangeeta program etc in Malad east Sanskruti Hall is the right place without any second thought.

featured_reviews.name: harshad padawe
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently held our engagement समारोह on 22nd February 2026 at this banquet hall, and overall, it was a wonderful experience.

The management team was very supportive and professional throughout the event. The décor was beautifully done and exactly as expected. A special thanks to Mr. Prajwal, who managed everything so smoothly and in such a polite and caring manner. He handled all arrangements like he was a part of our own family. His coordination and dedication truly made our day stress-free and memorable.

The team also adjusted many things as per our requests, which we really appreciated.

One small area of improvement would be the fog entry effect. I had opted for it, but the quality was not up to the mark and felt a bit low compared to expectations.

Apart from that, everything was well managed and the overall experience was very good. Thank you for making our special day memorable!

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Attended a wedding here last week and honestly, the hospitality stood out. The staff was courteous, the hall was spacious and clean, and the food was outstanding. Highly recommend for wedding functions.

featured_reviews.name: Yogendar Mayaroliya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to share some genuine feedback that I hope will be helpful in improving your services for future clients.
Compared to other banquet halls in the same location, your pricing appears to be significantly higher in relation to the services provided. Additionally, the rigid policies and limited flexibility give an impression of monopoly, which may not align well with today’s competitive and customer-focused environment.
On a personal note, during my event, I observed that the hygiene standards in the washrooms were not up to expectations. Furthermore, the behavior and professionalism of the serving staff could be improved, as it did not reflect the level of service one would expect at the given price point.
I am sharing this feedback purely with the intention of helping you enhance the overall experience for your future guests. I hope you will take these points into consideration
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We genuinely appreciate hearing from our clients, as it helps us review and improve our services.

Our pricing is structured based on multiple factors, including operational costs, staffing, infrastructure, compliance, and the level of support provided during events. While we strive to remain competitive within the area, we also ensure that all policies and terms are clearly communicated in advance to maintain transparency and smooth execution for all parties.

Regarding flexibility, we always try to accommodate requests wherever possible within operational limits, and as shared earlier, several extensions and adjustments were provided during your event without additional charges.

We take hygiene and service standards seriously. Washroom cleanliness and staff conduct are areas we continuously monitor, and your feedback has been noted and shared with the concerned teams for review and corrective action where required.

Your feedback has been received in the spirit it was shared, and we thank you for highlighting these points. We remain committed to improving and delivering a professional and reliable experience for our clients.

We wish you the very best ahead.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjeet Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: We attended a beautiful Maharashtrian wedding at Savita Banquet Hall and everything was so well managed. The food tasted just like home — especially the gulab Jamun and Starters. The staff was extremely polite and attentive. A perfect venue for traditional weddings.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the opportunity to organize my son’s 1st birthday celebration at Savita Banquet, and while the overall experience was good, there were definitely areas for improvement.

The location is great, with ample parking space, making it convenient for guests. The food and catering services were generally good, though I noticed that some of the roti and paratha seemed burnt, likely due to the quick cooking process.

The banquet hall itself offers enough space to comfortably accommodate 150 people, which is ideal for mid-sized events. However, I strongly recommend negotiating a discount, as their rates are on the higher side. I managed to book with a minimal discount, but before the event, the hall was undergoing renovations. While I was assured that everything would be completed in time, this was not the case. The unfinished walls were covered with golden cloths, which was not what I expected given the amount I paid.

Additionally, the changing rooms left a lot to be desired. The floors were dirty, the sofas had paint stains, and there were no mirrors or hooks available.

In conclusion, if you’re considering Savita Banquet for your event, make sure to push for a significant discount—around 30%. Otherwise, I’d suggest looking for alternatives.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Greetings, Sir. We offer some of the most competitive pricing for our banquet services. Prior to your reservation, we communicated the ongoing renovation work, to which you consented before proceeding with the booking. Additionally, we had previously informed you that the changing rooms were also undergoing renovations, and you indicated that this was acceptable. It is therefore inappropriate for you to raise complaints now. Furthermore, it is unrealistic to expect a 30% discount, as that exceeds our profit margin. I kindly ask you to reconsider your statements.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhant R Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm so frustrated with the parking situation at this venue .  We booked this hall for relatives engagement , and there's no parking available, forcing us to park on the roadside.  To make matters worse, the management is incredibly rude and unhelpful. Hoping the rest of the evening goes smoothly. Not recommended for you guys
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Greetings Sir!!

We possess a parking facility that can hold up to 10 vehicles and provide Valet Parking services for an extra fee.

As we are situated within walking distance from the station, it can occasionally be challenging to secure street parking, and we empathize with your frustration. My team may have been attempting to communicate this to you, and if you perceived them as impolite, I sincerely apologize for that.

featured_reviews.name: Usha Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: Manager and office staff of the hall are very soft spoken person. They use creativity in their work and present the best idea for the client taking into consideration of client's need. Food are delicious and look tempting. Decorations are also good. A budget friendly Banquet Hall.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid this venue at all costs. I strongly advise against booking this hall for any event due to the owner’s incredibly rude and unprofessional behavior.
​During our wedding, the owner repeatedly interrupted the ceremony to demand extra charges—simply because she wanted to go home early. Despite our repeated assurances that all payments would be settled immediately after the function, she continued to harass us, even threatening to shut off the stage lights in the middle of our event.
​To make matters worse, the service was terrible. The tea was served without sugar, and the hall was infested with mosquitoes. Her intervention turned our special moment into a stressful ordeal. Save yourself the trouble and look elsewhere.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We’re genuinely sorry that your experience felt stressful, and we’d like to clarify a few important points for accuracy and transparency.

Firstly, the bill settlement was not demanded early. Our representative approached you at 1:00 AM, after patiently waiting. If a lady waiting until 1 AM is considered “early,” we honestly do not know how else to interpret that statement.

Secondly, the food service timing was clearly communicated well in advance. Buffet service was scheduled only until 11:00 PM; however, the buffet was started from your end at 11:00 PM itself, which required our staff and labour to stay until 1:00 AM. The extra charges were pre-informed and agreed upon, and these charges go directly to the labour who stayed late to serve—none of this amount goes to the banquet management.

Additionally, the hall usage was extended by 1.5 hours, for which not a single rupee was charged, despite it being beyond the agreed timing.

Regarding the tea, sugar is normally kept on the side as per standard practice. However, upon request, our staff immediately mixed and served it accordingly.

Regarding the concern about mosquitoes, it is important to clarify that a non-AC hall was opted for after a certain hour. During this time, the main doors were kept widely open for ventilation, and the seating was arranged near the entrance. These factors can naturally increase exposure to mosquitoes.

That said, we do carry out regular pest-control measures, and we continue to review and improve wherever possible.

We always aim to be fair, transparent, and accommodating, and it is unfortunate that our efforts and flexibility during your event were overlooked. We wish you the very best ahead.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Majithia
featured_reviews.review_text: I won't suggest you all this banquet cz of my personal experience.. rate are high, food was okaish .. starter were worst. Also owner of Savita banquet, she was rude sometimes while talking.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We are sorry to see this rating. However, we are unable to trace any event associated with your name in our records.

At Savita Banquet Hall, we take guest experience very seriously, especially for weddings and special occasions. We kindly request you to share your event details with us so we can look into the matter and address your concern immediately. Our team is always available to resolve genuine issues.
